info.title: DivisionCero API
info.description: The records of a team. Create an API key in the team settings (Settings → API) and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The key decides the team and what it may read or write. Each key may make 300 requests per 60 seconds; every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset, and a key over its limit gets 429 with Retry-After.
